identity.correctionsToBrief: The brief's 'Andreas Ensemble (Andreas Bonnstraat / Lelylaan)' names the 2006-2011 redevelopment of the Andreas hospital site, not one building; this pand is its western perimeter block on the Cornelis Lelylaan, with the WestCord Fashion Hotel ('WestCord FASHION HOTEL' lettering on the 2020-2025 panoramas) in the north-west tower. There is no Andreas Bonnstraat; the streets are the Cornelis Lelylaan, the Titus van Rijnstraat and the Hendrikje Stoffelsstraat. The brief's 18 m is the OSM height; the 3DBAG roofs reach 29-36 m on the bar and 41-43 m on the hotel.
